redFlags: Positive pregnancy test with unilateral iliac fossa pain, syncope, or shoulder-tip pain (Ruptured Ectopic Pregnancy)
BP >= 160/110 mmHg with headache, visual scotomata, hyperreflexia/clonus, or RUQ pain (Severe Preeclampsia / Imminent Eclampsia)
